idx_tx_card.name: idx_tx_card
idx_tx_card.where: card_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

idx_tx_account.name: idx_tx_account
idx_tx_account.where: account_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

chk_income_account_xor_card.name: chk_income_account_xor_card
chk_income_account_xor_card.value: kind <> 'income' OR ((account_id IS NOT NULL) <> (card_id IS NOT NULL))

chk_expense_source.name: chk_expense_source
chk_expense_source.value: kind <> 'expense' OR source IS NOT NULL

chk_card_source.name: chk_card_source
chk_card_source.value: source IS DISTINCT FROM 'card' OR card_id IS NOT NULL

chk_transfer_fields.name: chk_transfer_fields
chk_transfer_fields.value: kind <> 'transfer' OR (transfer_from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND transfer_to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND transfer_value_cents > 0 AND transfer_from_account_id <> transfer_to_account_id)
